boundary: Branching and explicit real intertwiners do not create a complex structure. In particular the 81-sector remains parity-obstructed, and it contains only the sign-twisted 9-dimensional constituent.

explicit_maps.construction: Let M be the Reynolds average of the seed e_3 e_1^T from the residual 15-space to the signed 240-edge space. Let E9=(A_J-8I)(A_J-2I)/40. Apply the exact L1 spectral projector P24 and the spread-class projector P90. The reduced maps are A24=N24/2 and A90=N90/2.
explicit_maps.gram_identity: N24^T N24 = N90^T N90 = 4 E9_num, where E9=E9_num/40

subgroup_description: setwise stabilizer of the canonical six 5-point fibers; induced action on the fibers is S6
theorem: Under the exceptional S6 separator, the natural 9-dimensional constituent V_(4,2) occurs exactly once in the 24-sector and exactly once in the 90-sector, and in none of the 15,30,81 sectors. Two literal half-integral signed incidence maps A24=N24/2 and A90=N90/2 realize these copies; their primitive ternary numerators have rank 9, equal Gram 4E9_num, orthogonal images, and satisfy all 720 intertwining equations.
